sql: SELECT right(market_ticker,4) m, to_char(at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') t, best_yes_bid yb, best_no_bid nb, yes_depth_at_best yd, no_depth_at_best nd, round(no_depth_total) ndt, trades_last_5m tr FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE market_ticker LIKE 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH-TAT26DEC-2.%' AND at BETWEEN '2026-11-02 17:00' AND '2026-11-02 21:30' ORDER BY market_ticker, at
